toast.removedDesc: The source was disconnected. Existing restore points are kept.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: AltaStor will disconnect this source and drop its <1>{{hostPart}}</1> and <2>{{vmPart}}</2> from inventory. Backup jobs stop protecting them; existing restore points are kept.

vcenter.title: Connect a vCenter Server
vcenter.blurb: AltaStor connects to vCenter and enumerates its clusters, hosts and VMs. Backups use VADP changed-block tracking — nothing is installed in the guests.

esxiStandalone.title: Connect a standalone ESXi host
esxiStandalone.blurb: AltaStor connects directly to the ESXi host and discovers its VMs. Backups use VADP changed-block tracking — no vCenter required.

proxmox.title: Connect a Proxmox VE cluster
proxmox.blurb: AltaStor connects to the Proxmox API and enumerates its nodes and guests. Note: Proxmox dirty-bitmaps reset on a power-cycle, so the first backup after a reboot re-reads the full disk.

hyperv.title: Connect a Hyper-V host or cluster
hyperv.blurb: AltaStor registers the Hyper-V host and discovers its VMs. In the live appliance a host is onboarded by deploying the RCT backup agent over SSH.

addEnv.verifyTlsHelp: Recommended. Rejects untrusted, expired, or hostname-mismatched certificates.
addEnv.insecureWarning: Certificate verification is disabled. Use this only for a trusted lab endpoint while you install a valid certificate.
addEnv.hostCountHelp: Sizes the simulated cluster. Live discovery determines this automatically.
addEnv.hostCountError: Enter a host count between 1 and 16.
addEnv.credentialsNote: Credentials are used to authenticate to {{platform}}. Discovered VMs stay unprotected until a backup job includes them.
addEnv.doneDesc: They're in your inventory now, all unprotected — select the source in the estate tree to see its VMs, then create a backup job to start protecting them.
addEnv.errorDefault: The appliance couldn't connect to that endpoint.
addEnv.errorUnreachable: The appliance couldn't reach that endpoint. Check the address and credentials, then try again.

dialog.title: Add a Hyper-V host
dialog.description: The agent runs on the Hyper-V host and performs VSS-consistent, changed-block backups. AltaStor installs it over SSH — no reboot, no console access needed.
dialog.portHelp: The port the agent listens on. AltaStor opens it in the host firewall, scoped to the appliance. Default {{port}}.
dialog.credentialsNote: Credentials are used once, over SSH, to install the service. After that AltaStor authenticates with a per-host key pinned to this appliance — you won't need this password again.
dialog.credentialsNoteOndemand: SSH is then locked on the host; re-enable it before a future update or removal.
dialog.deployedHealthy: The agent is installed and reporting healthy.

startError.inProgress: A deploy for this host is already in progress.
startError.unreachable: Couldn't reach the appliance to start the deploy.

ssh.authTitle: SSH answered — the sign-in was rejected
ssh.authBody: Use a local administrator account on <1>{{host}}</1>. Double-check the username and password, then Retry.
ssh.enableTitle: Enable SSH on the Hyper-V host
ssh.enableBody: AltaStor couldn't reach OpenSSH on <1>{{host}}</1>. It's off by default on Windows — paste this into an elevated PowerShell on the host, then click Retry.
ssh.keyOnlyNote: Once enrolled, AltaStor authenticates with a per-host key — you can then require key-only SSH:

agent.name: AltaStor agent
agent.ondemandNote: On-demand SSH — sshd is locked on this host between operations. Re-enable SSH on <1>{{host}}</1> before Update, Redeploy or Remove; a run that can't connect will show the one-click enable script.
